Read the QC-control samples from an annotation file

Source: R/quality-score.R
qc_samples_from_annotation.Rd

Returns the Sample values that the annotation flags as experiment QC controls in qc_column (TRUE, T, 1, QC, qc, yes or Yes). This is how 01_mhc_overview turns its QCColumn param into the qc_samples of score_sample_quality(). A missing file, an unreadable annotation, an empty qc_column or a column the annotation does not have all give an empty vector, because QC tagging is optional.

Usage

qc_samples_from_annotation(annotation_file, qc_column = "QC")

Arguments

annotation_file

Path to the annotation csv (read with read_annot()).

qc_column

Name of the flag column (default "QC").

Value

A character vector of QC Sample names (possibly empty).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
qc_samples_from_annotation("1_documentation/sample_annotation.csv", "QC")
} # }
